newsitem.title: GERMANY: EMI details EU economic convergence in 1996.
newsitem.headline: EMI details EU economic convergence in 1996.

text.p: The European Monetary Institute (EMI) published the following economic convergence figures for the EU member countries in 1996 on Tuesday.

NOTE - The EMI released the data in its annual report. The data is based on EUROSTAT statistics, national data and European Commission information. The fiscal data is from autumn 1996. HICP refers to new data on Harmonised Indices of Consumer Prices.
* ** *** first, second and third best performer in terms of price stability.
# public deficit not exceeding 3 percent of GDP or public debt not exceeding 60 percent of GDP.
(c) As a percentage of GDP. Provisional for 1996. (European Commission autumn 1996 forecasts).

(d) General government gross debt figures are not adjusted for the assets held by the Danish Social Pension Fund against sectors outside general government, and for government deposits at the central bank for the management of foreign exchange reserves.
(e) In 1996 Ireland and Denmark were not the subject of an EU Council decision under Article 104c (6) of the Treaty that an excessive deficit exists.
(f) Greek interest rate data is the rate of a single issue of bonds on 14 February 1996.
(g) HICP inflation rates not available for 1996.
